name: Crucible for Plex
subtitle: Native client for your server
promotionalText: Your library, native on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV: a Resume-first Home, the system player, offline downloads and a Year in Review. No server? Try the built-in demo.
description:
Crucible is a native client for your Plex Media Server on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. It is built to feel like part of the system: the system player, native menus and context menus, Liquid Glass on the newest software, and a library that opens exactly where you left off.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Home opens on a Resume hero, then Continue Watching, Up Next and Recently Added. Library grids have filters for Unwatched and In Progress, genre and sort, an A–Z scrubber and folder browsing for unindexed content. Search groups results by type with a Top Result.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Skip Intro and Skip Credits from Plex markers, audio and subtitle menus, adjustable speed, lock screen controls and Up Next that rolls the next episode as the credits start. On iPhone and iPad: Picture-in-Picture and background audio. Direct play when your device can handle the file, automatic transcoding when it can't.

MADE FOR IPAD
A sidebar with every Plex library, layouts that fit every window from Slide Over to a full 13-inch screen, and several windows at once: open any title in its own window from its menu, or drag its card to the edge of the screen. With a Magic Keyboard, a full menu bar and shortcuts: Command-1 to 4 for the tabs, Command-F to search, Space to play, S to skip the intro, N for the next episode. Posters lift under the trackpad and Apple Pencil, and right-click opens every menu.

MADE FOR THE COUCH
The Apple TV app is built for the Siri Remote: a cinematic Home that follows focus, one tab per library, native context menus, search, and Top Shelf with Continue Watching and Up Next. Liquid Glass on tvOS 26.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
On iPhone and iPad, download movies, seasons or single episodes in the quality you pick. Transfers continue in the background, stay on Wi-Fi by default and, on iPhone, show a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Offline playback uses the same player.

KNOW YOUR VIEWING
Watch History grouped by day, Statistics with streaks, heatmaps, binges and taste built from your own Plex history, and a Year in Review poster you can share.

FREE TO USE, CRUCIBLE PRO TO GO FURTHER
Browsing, search and playback are free on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, and so is the Statistics view for the last week. Crucible Pro unlocks unlimited offline downloads, the full Statistics screen with every range and library filter, the Year in Review poster and Top Shelf. Pay once for lifetime access, or subscribe yearly with a 14-day free trial. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, and Family Sharing is on.

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER
No Plex server yet? Choose Try the demo on the welcome screen to explore a fictional library with everything unlocked, guided by a short tour.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account with us, no ads, no analytics. Crucible talks only to plex.tv and the server you choose.

OPEN SOURCE
Crucible is free software under GPL-3.0: https://github.com/guitaripod/Crucible

Crucible needs a Plex Media Server. Plex requires a Plex Pass or Remote Watch Pass to stream from your server away from home. Crucible is an independent app and is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Plex, Inc. Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc.

Crucible Pro Annual: 14-day free trial, then billed yearly at the price shown in the app. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/crucible/privacy
reviewNotes:
WHAT'S NEW
This fixes the Up Next card on iPhone and iPad. During the credits its second button is now Watch Credits, which closes the card and keeps the credits playing; before, it ended the player. Once the episode ends the button becomes Close. Apple TV already worked this way.

Crucible is a client for the user's own Plex Media Server and has no content of its own. Plex requires a paid Plex Pass or Remote Watch Pass to stream a server's video away from home (https://support.plex.tv/articles/requirements-for-remote-playback-of-personal-media/), so we cannot give App Review a free account that can stream remotely. We therefore ask for approval under Guideline 2.1(a) of a built-in demo mode with the app's full functionality.

HOW TO USE THE DEMO
iPhone and Apple TV: on the Welcome screen choose "Try the demo". It runs a fictional library (made-up titles, artwork and viewing history) from inside the app, so no account, server or network is needed. The demo has everything unlocked: Home with Continue Watching and Up Next, library grids with filters, sort and A-Z index, search, detail pages, playback with Skip Intro and Skip Credits, Up Next, audio and subtitle menus, Statistics, Watch History, and on iPhone Picture-in-Picture, offline downloads and the Year in Review poster. The You tab has a "Demo library" row with a guided tour. "Leave the demo" and "Connect your Plex server" return to the real Plex sign-in.

CRUCIBLE PRO (in-app purchases)
Products: com.guitaripod.crucible.pro.lifetime (non-consumable) and com.guitaripod.crucible.pro.yearly (auto-renewable subscription with a 14-day free trial), sold through RevenueCat. Both products are approved: they were reviewed and approved with the iPhone version 2.1.0 of this same app record, which is now on the App Store, and Apple TV shares them through universal purchase. In the previous Apple TV review the products were not yet approved, which is the likely reason the paywall could not load them. Playback is never gated. To see the paywall: iPhone, Settings > Crucible Pro; Apple TV, You > Crucible Pro; both also at the end of the demo tour ("See Crucible Pro"). Outside the demo, free installs see locks on the Statistics Month, Year and All ranges and the library filter, on the Year in Review poster, and on batch downloads. Restore Purchases is on the paywall and on the Crucible Pro screen.

OTHER NOTES
Downloads (iPhone) save media from the user's own server for offline viewing inside the app. Local network access is requested to reach servers on the user's home network; App Transport Security allows arbitrary loads because Plex servers on private addresses use HTTP or self-signed HTTPS. Crucible collects no personal data; the only third-party SDK is RevenueCat, for purchase validation.

whatsNew.IOS:
Up Next no longer takes the player down with it.

- During the credits, the card's second button is Watch Credits: it closes the card and lets the credits keep playing instead of ending playback
- Once the episode ends, the button becomes Close, so you can still end playback in one tap
- Watch Credits also brings back the Skip Credits control, so the credits are yours to skip
whatsNew.TV_OS:
The Home fixes reach the big screen.

- Continue Watching shows the time left and resumes where you stopped; titles that have not started move to Up Next
- Long-press a title for Play from Beginning, View Details, Go to Show and both Mark Watched and Mark Unwatched
